topic: Individual NACLO problem links are listed by year and title without explicit Round 1/2 designation. Do not infer individual round from alphabetic code or page ordering; seek official year-specific competition assignments or schedules.

Practice HTML explicitly lists individual problems, solutions and round compilations but not separately labeled marking rubrics. Check whether rubrics are published separately; solutions are not automatically criteria.

Official NACLO competition papers, student-contributed practice problems, sample problems and other-source problems coexist on the same practice page; keep distinct provenance and do not classify all as official competition tasks.

Verify grade 4 archive separately and year-by-year grade 3/4 criteria; registration page describes temporary password access for current competition materials, so do not bypass it or assume all historical criteria freely accessible.

OE I–VI model tests and prior final challenges are indexed, but exact year/round mappings and complete regional and school stages are not established. Check public HTML and rights; do not infer exhaustion.
OBOI, OBOB, OBOF and OBOQ index first-round tasks and answer keys for limited editions. Audit other stages, older years and distinction between Neps Academy programming tasks and downloadable PDFs.

SOIF archive lists 2022–2026 theoretical and experimental phases and TBF, but not every year has identical phase structure. Preserve stage and theory/experiment dimensions; audit absent pairs without assuming missing data.

Secondary Atlasmaths index attributes national/regional Moroccan math problems to OMM and regional contests; verify against original organizers and rights before promoting individual problem records to confirmed official status.
